16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

5815|721fd095.name: Kurgul
5815|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

1195-complete.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
1195-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1196-accept.text:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
1196-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1512-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1512-complete.text: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, $N. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
1512-complete.title: Love's Gift

1512-progress.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1512-progress.text: You have returned. Are you ready to battle a succubus?
1512-progress.title: Love's Gift

1513-accept.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1513-accept.text:
Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $N. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising $c.

When you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.
1513-accept.title: The Binding

1513-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1513-complete.text:
Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

You have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.

Leave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.
1513-complete.title: The Binding

1513-progress.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1513-progress.text:
When I look upon a succubus, my heart begins to soar... But at the same time, I can almost sense my soul's ebb, drifting away like the tides.

Be wary, my friend.
1513-progress.title: The Binding

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints
